$comment: D3's corrected measure for the pilot runs, read from each run's transcript by `measure:comparison -- usage` on 2026-10-14. inputProcessed sums every turn's input (uncached, cache read, cache written); finalContext is the last turn's. harnessTokens is the figure the pilot recorded, which matches finalContext rather than cost. The pilot's own records (plain-t1-p*.json) are left as scored.
